title: Enemy abilities can invalidate a familiar formation

applicability.game_version: Observed in RimWorld 1.6; revalidate behavior for the current game.
applicability.mods: RimMolt and ordinary gameplay; details can vary by version and other enabled mods.

observed: Fire reached a doorway defender and spread into a previously used defensive position.
explanation: A tactical hypothesis: insufficient distance and combustible access contributed to the failure.
recommendation: Inspect enemy capabilities; prepare positions, material protection and retreat routes for the actual attack.
exceptions: A different map, equipment or ability state may make another formation preferable.
verify: Verify ranges, lines of sight and escape routes in current geometry before advancing.
review: Reviewed source account; retain provisional status and avoid universal tactical claims.
